kiosk.headline: Predict the crowd before it arrives.
kiosk.sub: An AI digital twin of Dubai's busiest corridor. Pick an event, watch the crowd build, approve a plan.
kiosk.t1: Choose GITEX 2025 or Dubai Future Week, and drag the attendance to see how the crowd changes.
kiosk.t2: Drag the hour or tap any cell. Red outlines mark stations above comfortable capacity.
kiosk.t3Title: Ask for a plan — you decide
kiosk.t3: The twin proposes options and measures each one. Nothing happens until you approve.
kiosk.autoplay: Demo playing · touch to take control
